text: Chat about anything, with answers grounded in files and notes you have shared when relevant
quote: When relevant, it'll use any notes or documents you shared with it to respond.

text: Find relevant notes and documents using natural-language search
quote: Quickly find relevant notes and documents using natural language

text: Understands Word, PDF, org-mode, markdown, plaintext files and Notion pages
quote: Khoj can understand your word, PDF, org-mode, markdown, plaintext files, and Notion pages.

text: Index multiple sources, including Org-mode, Markdown, PDF, plaintext, GitHub repos and Notion pages
quote: Multiple Sources: Index your Org-mode, Markdown, PDF, plaintext files, Github repos and Notion pages

text: Notion integration lets you search and chat with your Notion workspaces
quote: The Notion integration allows you to search/chat with your Notion workspaces.

text: GitHub integration indexes as many repositories as you want
quote: The Github integration allows you to index as many repositories as you want.

text: Share files and folders through the app, and Khoj keeps them in sync for contextual search and chat
quote: Share your files, folders with Khoj using the app. Khoj will keep these files in sync to provide contextual responses when you search or chat.

text: Obsidian vault is automatically synced periodically by default
quote: By default, your Obsidian vault is automatically synced periodically.

text: Indexes your org-agenda files by default
quote: Khoj will index your org-agenda files, by default

text: Shows the reference notes used to generate a response
quote: Shows reference notes used to generate a response

text: Conversation file filters limit which notes are used in a chat response
quote: You can use conversation file filters to limit the notes used in the chat response.

text: /notes command restricts chat to answer only from your notes
quote: /notes: Limit chat to only respond using your notes, not just Khoj's general world knowledge as reference

text: Find notes similar to the current one
quote: Discover: Find similar notes to the current one

text: Incremental, search-as-you-type experience
quote: Incremental: Incremental search for a fast, search-as-you-type experience

text: Self-host on consumer hardware for privacy
quote: You can self-host on consumer hardware for privacy

text: Install the Khoj server with Docker or Pip
quote: You can install the Khoj server using either Docker or Pip.

text: Hosted Khoj Cloud option to get started quickly
quote: Try Khoj Cloud to get started quickly

text: Access Khoj from Emacs, Obsidian, the desktop app or any web browser
quote: Access it from your Emacs, Obsidian, the Khoj desktop app, or any web browser

text: Install Khoj on the desktop as a progressive web app
quote: You can also install the Khoj application on your desktop as a progressive web app.

text: Chat with Khoj on WhatsApp without any desktop client
quote: Without any desktop clients, you can start chatting with Khoj on WhatsApp.

text: Use chat models from Ollama through its local OpenAI-compatible server
quote: Ollama exposes a local OpenAI API compatible server. This makes it possible to use chat models from Ollama with Khoj.

text: Use Khoj without an internet connection when it is deployed on your personal computer
quote: You can even use Khoj without an internet connection if deployed on your personal computer.

text: Generate embeddings locally and use an offline chat model so data never leaves your machine
quote: You can generate your embeddings directly on your machine, and then use an offline chat client so that your data never leaves your machine.

text: Chat with many local or online LLMs, such as llama3, qwen, gpt, claude, gemini and deepseek
quote: Chat with any local or online LLM (e.g llama3, qwen, gemma, mistral, gpt, claude, gemini, deepseek).

text: Use OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini models by setting their API key environment variables
quote: Set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY to your API key if you want to use OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini commercial chat models

text: Connect any LLM behind an API via LiteLLM
quote: Using LiteLLM with Khoj makes it possible to turn any LLM behind an API into your personal AI agent.

text: Add multiple chat models and switch between them for different use cases
quote: Add all the chat models you want to try, use and switch between for your different use-cases.

text: Create agents with their own custom knowledge, persona, chat model and tools
quote: Create agents with custom knowledge, persona, chat model and tools to take on any role.

text: Run queries automatically on a schedule and receive the research results by email
quote: Automations allow you run your query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency. Khoj will send its research to you as an email.

text: Generate and run simple Python code for data analysis, plots and reports
quote: Khoj can generate and run simple Python code as well. This is useful if you want to have Khoj do some data analysis, generate plots and reports.

text: Researches the internet to ground responses when fresh information is needed
quote: Khoj will research on the internet to ground its responses, when it determines that it would need fresh information

text: Explicitly trigger an online search with the /online prefix
quote: You can also explicitly trigger an online search by adding the /online prefix to your chat query.

text: Online search works out of the box with SearxNG in the standard Docker Compose setup
quote: If you're using Docker, online search should work out of the box with searxng using our standard docker-compose.yml.

text: Slash commands give quick access to Khoj features
quote: Use slash commands to quickly access Khoj features

text: Generate images from a prompt with /dream
quote: /dream: Generate an image in response to your prompt.

text: Voice chat available on the web, desktop and Obsidian apps
quote: You can talk to Khoj using your voice. ... You can use voice chat on the web, Desktop, and Obsidian apps.

text: Play any message aloud via a speaker icon
quote: You can also click on the speaker icon next to any message to hear it out loud.

text: Optional authentication with Magic Links or Google OAuth
quote: if you want to enable authentication, you can do so either with with Magic Links or Google OAuth

text: Admin panel to configure Khoj server settings
quote: The admin panel allows you to configure various settings for your Khoj server.

text: Customize models, host URL and which features are enabled
quote: Customization: You can customize Khoj to your liking, from models, to host URL, to feature enablement.

text: Opt out of telemetry with the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable
quote: you can opt out of telemetry at any time by setting the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable to True
